title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

title: Compiler Engineer - Algorithmic Workloads Compilation
description:
About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Help push the boundaries of what can run on our accelerator. You’ll design compiler IRs and lowering strategies to support algorithmic workloads with irregular or dynamic control flow—loops, branches, and iterative methods—going beyond static neural networks. Working side by side with hardware engineers, you’ll influence ISA and execution model co-design to unlock new algorithm classes on analog and digital subsystems. The result: a compiler that makes complex algorithms practical to deploy while staying seamless for developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Extend compiler IRs to represent algorithms not easily captured in DNN graphs including control flow and iterative computation
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify analog compute with digital subsystems while maintaining performance and correctness
  • Prototype and optimize algorithms with irregular or dynamic control flow in compiler IRs, applying techniques such as vectorization, predication, and scheduling
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to co-design ISA and features that improve support for algorithmic workloads
  • Define a roadmap for higher-level programming abstractions that simplify prototyping and accelerate deployment

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in compilers or high-performance systems software
  • Proficiency in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python
  • Familiarity with compiler IRs (e.g., MLIR, LLVM, or equivalent) and their use representing complex program structures
  • Solid foundation in program analysis and optimization techniques (e.g., SSA form, loop optimizations, vectorization)

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Hands-on experience developing MLIR or LLVM dialects for control flow (e.g. scf, cf) or affine/polyhedral representations.
  • Background in compiler-hardware co-design: working with hardware designers to refine ISA or execution models for efficiency
  • Proven ability to prototype irregular or control-flow algorithms in compiler IRs and optimize them for performance and resource constraints
  • Experience extending ML compiler stacks (ONNX, IREE, XLA, PyTorch, TVM) to support workloads beyond DNNs

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make algorithmic and control-flow-heavy workloads practical on novel accelerator hardware.
  • A role that bridges compiler design and hardware co-design, shaping both the IR and the accelerator architecture.
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

title: Werkstudent*in Embedded Software
description:
Ein guter Sensor fällt im Alltag nicht auf, weil die Software dahinter einfach zuverlässig läuft. Genau daran arbeitest du bei uns in Wedel, neben deinem Studium. Dein Code landet nicht irgendwo in der Schublade, sondern in Maschinen, die jeden Tag funktionieren müssen. Wenn dir das mehr bedeutet als ein Vorzeigeprojekt, bist du hier richtig.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und der lässt sich nicht mit halbgaren Lösungen oder endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen erfüllen.

Wenn du Lust hast, Software zu schreiben, die in echten Maschinen zuverlässig arbeitet, dann lass uns sprechen. Schick uns deine Unterlagen und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an Embedded Software reizt.

Aufgaben

Von Beginn an arbeitest du an echten Aufgaben, die direkt in unsere Sensoren und Maschinen einfließen:

  • Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung von Embedded Software auf ARM-Cortex-Mikrocontrollern, vorrangig STM32

  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Firmware und Sensor-Bibliotheken

  • Unterstützung bei der Anbindung von Schnittstellen wie CANopen, IO-Link, Profinet oder EtherCAT

  • Mitarbeit beim Testen von Software- und Hardwaremodulen

  • Dokumentation der Ergebnisse im Kontext funktionaler Sicherheit

  • Gemeinsame Code Reviews im Team, bei denen du mitlernst und mitgestaltest

  • Schrittweise Übernahme eigener Teilaufgaben mit Unterstützung aus dem Team

  • Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams

Qualifikationen

  • Du hast Lust, Dinge wirklich zu durchdenken, und bringst dafür folgende Grundlagen mit:

  • Eingeschriebene*r Student*in der Informatik, technischen Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder Systemtechnik

  • Erste Erfahrung in der Embedded-Software-Entwicklung, idealerweise aus Studium oder Projekten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit C; Kenntnisse in Python, .NET oder C# sind von Vorteil

  • Eigenständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Blick aufs Ganze

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Freude am Austausch über Ergebnisse

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Präzise und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Kenntnisse in Buskommunikation oder Funksystemen – von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Echtzeitbetriebssystemen auf Mikrocontrollern – von Vorteil

  • Vertrautheit mit Git als Versionsverwaltungssystem – von Vorteil

Benefits

Wir sind ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen, das Wert auf kurze Entscheidungswege und eine “Open-Door-Mentalität“ legt. Unser Team profitiert von einer wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur, in der die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf großgeschrieben wird. Neben abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden zahlreiche Benefits:

  • Persönliches Mentoring – schneller ankommen, schneller wachsen

  • Option auf Abschlussarbeit und Übernahme – wir denken über den Campus hinaus

  • Firmenevents – vernetzen, feiern, wachsen

  • Firmenfitness über Wellhub – Zugang zu Partner-Studios, Online-Classes und Wellness, flexibel nutzbar.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Optionen – damit Studium und Job entspannt zusammenpassen

Bewerbung und Ablauf

Nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung bekommst du innerhalb einer Woche eine Antwort von Christine, Betül oder Alina. Das erste Kennenlerngespräch findet in der Regel online über MS-Teams statt. Im zweiten Schritt laden wir dich meist persönlich zu uns vor Ort ein. Ganz unkompliziert.

Dein Interesse ist geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams. Bei uns erwartet dich ein motiviertes Team, spannende Herausforderungen und die Möglichkeit, dich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du hast Fragen? Schreib uns direkt- wir melden uns.

title: Android Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

As a Talent Operations Specialist on our Global Talent Team, you’ll be the engine behind how we hire, combining sharp coordination, smart systems and a strategic mindset to help us hire smarter, faster and better.

This role blends exceptional interview coordination with talent strategy support and ownership of our TA operations. You'll use automation and AI to free up recruiter capacity, keep our hiring systems and vendors running smoothly, and raise the bar on the experience we give candidates and hiring leaders. This role reports to our Senior Director of Global GTM Recruiting, and supports a global team across the US, EMEA & APJ.

About Global Talent at Dataiku

We're not just filling roles. We're building the strongest possible teams, aligned to real business needs and backed by a world-class approach to talent. Our Global Talent exists to act as partners to the business and make talent a strategic lever rather than a reactive function.

  • Join a forward-looking Global Talent function at a company shaping the future of AI.
  • Work in a global, collaborative environment that values curiosity, precision and impact.
  • Play a hands-on role across the talent lifecycle, from how talent is identified and evaluated to how it's hired and supported.

What you'll do

Interview scheduling and candidate experience

  • Own end-to-end interview scheduling across regions and time zones, streamlining scheduling and pipeline tasks with automation tools and AI agents.
  • Deliver a best-in-class candidate experience from first outreach to offer.
  • Be the trusted logistics partner for recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Identify and implement low-lift, high-impact process improvements.

Talent strategy

  • Support talent mapping and the building of proactive talent pools.
  • Help prepare calibration sessions and post-hire reviews.
  • Put Dataiku's competency framework into practice across hiring and talent workflows.
  • Track patterns, surface insights and continuously refine how we assess and onboard talent.

TA operations and systems

  • Act as the main point of contact for our TA vendors, including Greenhouse, GoodTime, BrightHire and LinkedIn, managing CSM relationships, business reviews and renewals.
  • Administer our TA tech stack, including user provisioning, templates and system settings, and resolve Greenhouse to Workday hire sync issues so onboarding and payroll stay on track.
  • Keep our hiring processes compliant, including candidate data deletion and anonymization, and partner with Legal on offer template updates.
  • Partner with People Systems to test and scale new AI scheduling and feedback tools, and to make sure upcoming system changes land on time.
  • Lead the monthly TA Ops Essentials session, sharing new tool features and process updates with the TA team.
  • Manage TA procurement, including vendor and agency intake through Coupa and Ironclad, and agency purchase orders.
  • Own TA communication channels, including support tickets, Glassdoor review responses and our monthly Hot Jobs post.

What you'll need to be successful

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations or a fast-paced People function.
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse or a similar ATS, and familiarity with tools such as GoodTime, BrightHire, Gem or AI agents.
  • Experience administering recruiting systems and integrations (for example, Greenhouse and Workday) and managing vendor relationships.
  • A solid understanding of candidate data privacy and hiring compliance.
  • You're highly organized and calm under pressure, and you enjoy working through complexity and ambiguity.
  • You're comfortable working across cultures, time zones and competing priorities.
  • You're excited by automation and AI, and eager to apply them in your day-to-day work.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently with candidates, recruiters and executives alike.
  • You're curious, detail-oriented and mission-driven.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to competency-based hiring or performance frameworks.

#LI-CM

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

title: Mid Market Accounting Support Specialist
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

Cloudbeds is looking for a Senior Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting to own our most complex customer accounting work. This role sits at the intersection of hospitality operations, accounting, and technology, guiding properties through the end-to-end accounting flow, from property configuration to integration with their accounting software or ERP.

As the senior member of the team, you'll take on the hardest implementations and escalations, including multi-property and enterprise customers, be the go-to expert for Support, Onboarding and Account Management on anything accounting, and help shape how we onboard and support customers' financial setups as we scale. This is a customer-facing role for someone with deep accounting knowledge who can legitimately help our customers get their books right.

Our Onboarding & Accounting Integration Team:

Our team thrives at the intersection of hospitality expertise and technical execution. We work alongside Integration Engineering, Support, and Sales to solve real customer challenges with accounting systems. Customers trust us to help them connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds, and we take that seriously.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead complex accounting onboarding engagements, including multi-property and enterprise customers: chart of accounts mapping, tax configuration, revenue recognition, reconciliation workflows, and month-end close
• Act as the escalation point for accounting discrepancies, integration sync issues and configuration problems that Support and Onboarding can't resolve, and own them through to resolution
• Guide customers in connecting Cloudbeds to accounting software and ERPs (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, local and regional systems) via native integrations and partner solutions
• Serve as the subject matter expert on hospitality accounting for internal teams and customers, coaching other specialists and training Support, Onboarding and Account Management
• Build and own onboarding playbooks, documentation and best-practice resources for hospitality accounting workflows
• Bring recurring customer pain points and product gaps to Product and Engineering with clear evidence, and help shape the accounting roadmap
• Manage multiple complex engagements at once while keeping implementations moving and customers confident

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 8+ years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial operations, ideally in hospitality, travel, or a related industry
• Deep understanding of accounting fundamentals: general ledger, accounts receivable/payable, revenue recognition, reconciliation, month-end close, and financial reporting
• Proven track record leading accounting software or ERP implementations end to end, including complex or multi-entity setups
• Experience as the go-to expert others escalate to, with the ability to coach and train colleagues
• Strong customer-facing communication skills, able to explain complex accounting concepts in clear, simple language to hoteliers and translate accountant needs for technical teams
• Strong analytical mindset: trace data flows, identify mapping issues, and troubleshoot integration problems methodically
• Fluent in English, able to communicate clearly in writing and on calls across global time zones

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Accounting certification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) or ERP certifications
• Hotel accounting experience, including night audit, folio management or USALI
• Knowledge of regional accounting standards and tax requirements across Latin America or Europe, and Spanish or Portuguese

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Cloudbeds Awards:

  • Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

  • Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

  • Remote First, Remote Always

  • PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

  • Fully Paid Parental Leave

  • Home office stipend based on country of residency

  • Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

  • Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. title: Software Verification Engineer
description:
Join the elite team at QDSS where our engineers are at the forefront of developing cutting-edge Aerospace, Defense, Space, and Medical Device products. Your work will make a real impact, contributing to the core of engineering solutions that drive technological advancements.

Quest Defense Systems and Solutions is seeking to hire Software Verification Engineers with experience in safety-critical embedded systems to support advanced aerospace and defense programs.

You’ll be verifying and validating software running on RTOS-based, multicore SoC architectures, ensuring compliance with DO-178C and alignment to system-level requirements. This includes hands-on work across integration, system test, and software verification (HLR/LLR) in complex hardware/software environments.

Location: Remote (Strong preference for hybrid/onsite in Endicott, NY)
Due to the nature of this work, all applicants must be U.S. Citizens.

This role is ideal for engineers who understand the added complexity multicore introduces in certification, including timing, determinism, and partitioning concerns.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or a related engineering discipline
  • 2+ years of relevant Software Engineering experience in avionics or electronic controls embedded development in a safety or mission-critical environment (ie: aerospace, military).
  • Experience developing or developing on top of an RTOS (real-time operating system), as well as familiarity with RTOS concepts.
  • Experience with developing software to DO-178C standards.
  • Experience with C, Python.
  • Experience with Integration and Test at both system levels (HW/SW integration) as well as software test (HLR/LLR).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Asymmetric Multiprocessing
  • Experience with debug concepts on complex multi-core SoC.
  • Master’s degree in software engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience with ARM processors, associated System on Chip features, and ARM toolsets like ARM Dev Studio IDE and ARM DStream Probe.
  • Experience developing device drivers/board support packages.
  • Familiar with data transfer protocols (ARINC 615A, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, PCIe, LIN, CAN).
  • Familiar with security concepts (authentication, authorization, confidentiality).
  • Familiarity with actuators and sensors like stepper/torque motors, solenoids, relays, VDT, VRT, etc.
  • Experience BVA (boundary value analysis), SCA (structural coverage analysis), DCCA (data and control coupling analysis).
  • Experience with DO-330 Tool Qualification.
  • Good soft skills: communication, ability to perform active listening, self-manage, raise/elevate roadblocks and hiccups, communicate clearly, and take direction.
  • Good general understanding of engineering principles to be able to adapt to new projects/environments and come up to speed quickly.
  • Team leadership experience, including project technical leadership and/or software functional leadership.
  • Experience in the adoption and/or integration of emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

  • Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.

Benefits Include

  • Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. You’ll support these customers using our standard methods, backed by additional training on how non-Cloudbeds PMS solutions and the tools around them operate. Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals delivering exceptional experiences across live chat, email and phone. description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset.

title: SIU Investigator, Auto Claims
description:
What you're applying for

We're looking for an experienced SIU Investigator, Auto Claims to help protect honest policyholders and keep sophisticated fraud networks from gaming the system — while making sure legitimate claims move fast. You'll join our Claims team at a pivotal moment, bringing specialized investigative expertise to high-risk files as we expand into key markets like Florida and keep pushing the boundaries of what modern fraud detection looks like.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Lead end-to-end SIU investigations on complex auto claims — Physical Damage, Bodily Injury, and PIP/Medical Payments — with full ownership from referral to resolution

  • Identify and dismantle multi-claim fraud networks, staged accident rings, and coordinated medical billing schemes using link analysis and pattern-recognition techniques

  • Apply deep working knowledge of Florida PIP statutes, medical fee schedules, and the 14-day treatment rule to counter state-specific fraud trends

  • Partner directly with our Data Science and Product teams to test and refine predictive fraud models, feeding real-world case intelligence back into automated detection

  • Investigate emerging digital fraud risks — AI-manipulated damage photos, synthetic media, and altered records — using the latest AI tools and digital research platforms

  • Support EUOs, state fraud bureau referrals, and case strategy alongside claims adjusters and legal counsel

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of dedicated SIU auto claims investigative experience, with a track record on complex, high-stakes cases

  • Deep Florida PIP and BI expertise — statutes, treatment windows, billing mill fraud, and EUO dynamics

  • Hands-on experience with intelligence platforms like ISO ClaimSearch, Accurint, TLOxp, or LexisNexis

  • Proven ability to investigate large-scale, multi-jurisdictional organized fraud rings and billing syndicates

  • Genuine curiosity about AI — both as an investigative asset and as a fraud threat vector you'll need to stay ahead of

  • A college degree, preferably in criminal justice, insurance, or a related field

  • Ability to work in a remote environment

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $70,000 - $80,000 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

title: Freelance Question Reviewers
description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.
