title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers bilingue allemand H/F
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

 

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de sa gestion comptable et financière.

 

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients et traites leurs demandes dans ces deux langues, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, en lien avec nos équipes internes. Tu contribues ainsi à leur offrir une expérience de support claire, réactive et adaptée à leurs besoins.

 

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

 

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou une solution à ton interlocuteur ou, quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 

Tu prends en charge les demandes des clients en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et transmets les éléments utiles aux équipes internes. Tu assures le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution et veilles à communiquer de manière claire à chaque étape.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu te familiarises avec les besoins des clients, notamment en Allemagne, et commences à traiter leurs demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne : tu analyses la situation, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches une solution adaptée.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes en français, formalises les éléments utiles à l’investigation et assures le suivi des demandes escaladées.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits sur leurs besoins et les difficultés rencontrées.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

  • Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

  • Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 

Profil recherché

 

  • Tu es bilingue allemand / français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Tu peux accompagner les clients et traiter leurs demandes dans les deux langues, et collaborer au quotidien en français avec les équipes internes.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets parfois techniques ou financiers de façon claire, faire preuve d’écoute et adapter ta communication à ton interlocuteur.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour investiguer une demande, en assurer le suivi et solliciter les bonnes équipes lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

  • Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

  • À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

  • Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Nathan Robinet - Senior Team Lead Customer Support - Financial Services (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

Final Details

title: Werkstudent:in Founder's Associate Tech (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

NemoVote ist ein Startup, das Organisationen sichere, geheime und DSGVO-konforme Online-Wahlen und Live-Abstimmungen ermöglicht. Dabei vertrauen uns bereits über 1.000 Kunden.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und flachen Hierarchien. Wer anpackt, kann bei uns schnell etwas bewegen. Deine Arbeit hat direkte Wirkung: Was du heute umsetzt, sehen unsere Kund:innen oft schon morgen.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO, CTO und COO zusammen und bist bei uns die technische Anlaufstelle für ganz unterschiedliche Themen. So lernst du Technik, Betrieb und Strategie aus erster Hand kennen und siehst, wie ein Startup von innen funktioniert. Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

Rahmen

  • Werkstudent:in mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. In den Semesterferien kannst du auf Wunsch auf bis zu 40 Stunden aufstocken.

Oder Praktikant:in

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Freitag ist unser fester Office-Tag, an dem das ganze Team zusammenkommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Software Development: Du passt Anwendungen wie unsere Next.js-Website an, entwickelst sie weiter und hältst sie aktuell. Dazu gehören auch SEO, Tracking und unsere Google-Ads-Kampagnen.

  • Technischer Support: Du kümmerst dich um technische Probleme und Fragen unserer Kund:innen und findest Lösungen.

  • Sales-Support: Du unterstützt unseren Vertrieb bei technischen Fragen und Anforderungen von Interessent:innen und hilfst, unseren Vertriebsprozess in HubSpot weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren.

  • Startup-Alltag: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und bringst deine Ideen ein, wo du Verbesserungspotenzial siehst.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in in einem informatiknahen Studiengang wie Informatik, Medieninformatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik und schon fortgeschritten im Studium.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen sammeln können.

  • Webtechnologien: HTML, CSS und TypeScript/JavaScript sind dir vertraut. Idealerweise hast du schon mit einem Framework wie Angular, React oder Next.js gearbeitet.

  • AI im Blut: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code oder willst genau das richtig lernen. Dabei verstehst du den generierten Code gut genug, um ihn zu prüfen und dafür geradezustehen.

  • Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären, auch Menschen ohne IT-Hintergrund.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, packst gerne an und hast Lust auf Abwechslung statt Routine.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit CEO, CTO und COO: Du lernst direkt vom Führungsteam und bekommst Einblick in alle Bereiche, von der Technik über die Prozesse bis zur Unternehmensstrategie.

  • Echte Verantwortung von Anfang an, keine Kaffee-Aufgaben.

  • Moderner Tech-Stack: Durchgängig TypeScript, im Backend auf Node.js. Unsere Abstimmungsplattform läuft auf Angular und NestJS mit GraphQL und WebSockets, die Website auf Next.js, React und Tailwind. Dazu MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis und Keycloak. Deployed wird mit Docker und GitLab CI auf unsere eigene Infrastruktur mit Coolify.

  • Dein Setup, deine Wahl: Ob Mac, Windows oder Linux, du entscheidest, mit welchem Betriebssystem du arbeitest.

  • AI-first Engineering: Bei uns entsteht Software konsequent mit AI. Mit Claude Code arbeitest du agentisch und extrem effizient, von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis zu den Tests. Jede Änderung geht trotzdem durch ein manuelles Code-Review im Team. So lernst du, schnell zu liefern, ohne bei der Qualität Abstriche zu machen.

  • Startup-Atmosphäre: kleines Team, kurze Entscheidungswege, Raum für eigene Ideen.

  • Startup-Netzwerk im AI xpress: Du arbeitest Tür an Tür mit anderen Startups, tauschst dich aus und knüpfst Kontakte in der Gründerszene.

  • Flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten: Freitags ist Office-Tag.

  • EGYM Wellpass: Du trainierst in tausenden Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbädern und Sportkursen in ganz Deutschland.

  • Mitarbeiterangebote: Du bekommst Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken und Anbietern, etwa für Technik, Mode oder Reisen.

Klingt nach dir?

Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht: Erzähl uns einfach, warum du Lust auf NemoVote hast.

title: Content Creator - YouTube
description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. title: Harness Research Engineer | 36labs
description:
Role: Harness Research Engineer

Company: 36 Labs

Location: London, in the office four days a week (Baker Street now, moving to Primrose Hill within a couple of months). London-based candidates only. No visa sponsorship is available at the moment.

Job Type: Full-time

About 36 Labs

36 Labs is an applied AI research firm in London. It is teaching models what captures human attention on social media, and it starts with creativity. The founders see a creative process as a tree of decisions. LLMs are poor at that, and they are poor at explaining why a creative choice was made.

The product is a harness that sits over any frontier model, especially video generation models. An autonomous marketing service runs on it, from ideation to generation to distribution. The content goes to real audiences, and the results feed a data loop that improves the harness. Clients so far are mainly music companies, including Sony, Warner and Universal. Marketing is a proof of concept. The company does not see itself as a marketing business.

The company is profitable and is closing its first seed round in the next couple of weeks. V3 of the harness is being released internally, and the scope of work is large. The founders are sure of the direction. They need someone to own delivery. Today only one or two people can work on the harness, so you would be one of the first. This is a new role, created by the next stage of growth.

The stack is Python, TypeScript, Postgres, LLM and generative model APIs, and open-weight models.

What you are expected to do:

  • Continue developing the harness, including the V3 release.

  • Take ownership of delivering the harness. The direction is set, and getting it built is your job.

  • Build and run benchmarks and evals.

  • Own the evaluation pipeline for the harness, across text, video and images.

  • Turn fuzzy quality questions into validated evaluation models for open-ended agent tasks.

What you need to succeed:

Experience

  • You have 4+ years of experience and have owned something before, from start to finish.

  • You are a hands-on engineer in the AI-native era and can work independently.

  • Agents and evals are the company's main priorities. You have shipped evals for outputs that cannot be tracked automatically, such as open-ended, non-numerical tasks.

  • Ideally you have shipped an agent system with real users and workloads. It relies on models, calls tools and acts on the results of planning steps. A basic chat interface with retrieval behind it is not enough, and neither is agent work limited to data extraction.

  • You can work from the London office four days a week and do not need visa sponsorship right now. A visa valid until next June, for example, is fine. A month's notice is fine too. Starting earlier is preferred, though November or December is acceptable.

Nice to have

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, maths, stats or similar. An MSc or PhD is great. With a BSc only, you need to be really good. The university matters less than what you have built.

  • Experience with multimodal models or post-training.

  • A background in applied generative media or creative companies, such as Fal.

  • Projects beyond university or your day job, and a habit of keeping up with new stacks, models and practices.

How you work

  • You have high agency. You take the lead and need little hand-holding.

  • You do things first and ask forgiveness later, and you are open to being disagreed with.

  • You explain your ideas clearly to the team and leave your ego at the door.

What you get:

  • Real ownership. You would own the delivery of the harness, which only one or two colleagues can work on today.

  • Work on a problem few other companies are tackling. The team believes that solving creativity in LLMs would solve the human attention economy, and they see a very high ceiling.

  • Clients such as Sony, Warner and Universal.

  • Fast learning at a seed-stage company, which is also a strong line on a CV.

  • Room to grow into a more senior role. The CTO is expected to step back from the code over the long term.

  • A pace that is extremely fast and comes without stability. The team sees that as a good thing, and we want you to know it upfront.

How to apply

Send your LinkedIn profile or CV, with a short note on the projects you are proudest of, to your contact at the agency. Use the subject line "Harness Research Engineer, 36 Labs". The process starts with a short pre-screen call with the agency. Next comes a conversation with Benedict, head of operations, then a technical interview of about 30 minutes with the CTO, then a take-home assessment. If the team is torn between strong candidates, there may be a final session on-site in the office.

title: Field Deployment Engineer, Northern Europe
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

  • Reporting to: Manager, Regional Support & Technical Account Management
  • Travel expectations: up to ~40% (variably in-country and across Benelux, Nordics, and Baltics)
  • Location: working remotely unless you are travelling to customer sites

Your Impact

As the Deployment Engineer, you will be tasked with driving customer success and technical adoption of Axon products and solutions, with the objective of grant a successful adoption and use of our technology for the Public Safety and adjacent sectors in the region. Axon is seeking professionals that can work at the tactical level and drive a successful adoption through persistence and execution.

Your Day to Day

  • Become the dedicated technical expert across the Axon ecosystem, maintaining deep knowledge of both current and expanding product deployments.
  • Serve as a technical liaison between Axon, the customer, and any strategic delivery partners.
  • Follow-up on all requests submitted from customers.
  • Work with the sales team to support existing customers.
  • Manage tickets and RMA and work with internal teams from the identify of an issue and through the entire life cycle of the adoption.
  • Travel may be required, up to 40%, nationally and internationally.
  • Coordinate and schedule regular calls with existing customers.
  • Focus on customer loyalty
  • Proactively look out for customers’ business, suggesting new and innovative ways to keep them succeeding with Axon products
  • Facilitate integration with existing customer platforms.
  • Installation and commissioning

What You’ll Bring

  • Fluent Dutch and English written and verbal communication skills is essential.
  • Tactically focused on managing customer success adoption.
  • Mission driven mentality, highly motivated, with a drive to execute on tasks.
  • Strong technical foundation including working knowledge of:
    • Enterprise networking including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
    • SaaS platforms, cloud applications, APIs, identity management, authentication, and enterprise software administration.
    • Windows environments, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise endpoint management concepts.
    • Integration patterns, system interoperability, and enterprise application ecosystems.
    • Technical troubleshooting across software, networking, configuration, and infrastructure domains.
  • The ability to legally live in territory, and travel to other countries as required. This may require you to personally obtain work and travel visas.
  • The ability to work with all levels in an organization effectively and build strong partnerships.
  • Strong computer skills - proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and collaboration tools (i.e. Salesforce, Trello, etc.).

Champion Public Safety Outcomes: Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.

Collaborate with Internal Teams: Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.

Navigate UK Public Sector Procurement: Work with force commercial and procurement teams, national frameworks and police-owned commercial routes to structure compliant, competitive routes to market, and manage the associated governance and approvals.

Accurate CRM Management: Maintain up-to-date records of customer interactions, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce. Use this data to drive proactive sales strategies and ensure visibility for internal stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators

Develop strong relationships within the UK team and across other divisions throughout Axon to serve as an advocate for our UK customers.

Contract & Negotiation Leadership: Lead the proposal and negotiation process for contracts, ensuring competitive positioning and successful long-term engagements, including through framework call-offs and direct award processes where applicable.

Forecasting Accuracy: Deliver accurate, data-driven forecasts with a 90%+ accuracy rate, maintaining transparency and proactive communication with senior management about your pipeline and expected deal closure.

Public Sector Sales Experience: Deep understanding of UK public sector procurement and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

Solution-Oriented Mindset: Ability to translate complex customer needs into innovative Axon solutions, helping forces enhance public safety, officer accountability and efficiency.

Technical Acumen: Familiarity with cloud computing, SaaS solutions and (preferably) digital evidence management systems. Experience working with police IT and digital leaders to drive cloud and digital transformation initiatives.

Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to work cross-functionally within an organisation to deliver comprehensive, high-impact customer solutions. Leadership experience in managing multi-stakeholder projects is a plus.

title: Sr Clinical Research Associate (Spain)
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Spain and Portugal, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Portugal and Spain.
  • Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution.
  • Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance.
  • Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets.
  • Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required.
  • Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred.
  • Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out.
  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred.
  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred.
  • Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location.
  • Valid driver’s licence required.
  • Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish and Portuguese

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Systems Engineer – Nuclear I&C / BWR
description:
Shape the future of innovation as we tackle cutting-edge projects that make a difference. We’re not just in the business of engineering—we’re building a brighter future. Driven by creativity and a culture of excellence, we believe in the power of engineering to solve today’s challenges and create opportunities for tomorrow. What we do matters.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions (QDSS) is seeking an experienced Systems Nuclear Engineer to support the design, modernization, and modification of complex nuclear power plant systems. This role will work across multidisciplinary engineering teams to evaluate plant-level requirements, support system and subsystem design, and ensure proposed changes meet applicable safety, regulatory, licensing, and operational requirements.

This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. Candidates must be US Citizens or US Permanent Residents.

The ideal candidate will bring strong nuclear power design engineering experience with specific knowledge of Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) plants. This position requires a systems-level understanding of how mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls (I&C), software, hardware, and FPGA-based systems interact within a nuclear power environment. Experience with reactor protection, nuclear I&C, plant modernization, and legacy GE BWR architectures is highly valued.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Translate plant-level, operational, and nuclear safety requirements into allocated system and subsystem requirements.
  • Decompose and allocate requirements across mechanical, electrical, hardware, software, FPGA, instrumentation, and control implementations.
  • Develop, maintain, and review system descriptions, design specifications, interface requirements, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), cabinet drawings, elementary drawings, and connection/route drawings.
  • Evaluate proposed changes to mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, control, protection, and safety systems.
  • Support the development and review of engineering change packages and plant design modifications.
  • Perform requirements quality, completeness, consistency, and traceability reviews.
  • Participate in technical and design reviews, Technical Specification markups, and licensing-related reviews.
  • Evaluate potential nuclear safety, design-basis, and licensing impacts associated with design changes.
  • Support resolution of technical issues, test anomalies, nonconformances, and design discrepancies.
  • Perform or support functional analysis, requirements analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA/FMECA), single-failure analysis, and design-basis evaluations.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure system interfaces and requirements are properly understood and implemented.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear, Systems, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of nuclear power plant design engineering experience, preferably with GE-designed Boiling Water Reactors (BWRs).
  • Solid knowledge of Reactor Protection Systems (RPS), Instrumentation & Controls (I&C), neutron monitoring, safety-related instrumentation, trip logic, and digital/analog control systems, including NUMAC or comparable GE platforms.
  • Understanding of BWR design and licensing requirements, safety classifications, equipment/environmental qualification, seismic requirements, failure analysis, Technical Specifications, and surveillance requirements.
  • Experience with engineering requirements analysis, FMEA/FMECA, single-failure analysis, and design-basis evaluations.
  • Ability to assess plant system interactions, evaluate legacy GE BWR designs, support design changes, and document nuclear safety and licensing impacts.
  • Strong technical writing, requirements development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct GE BWR design experience or previous GE Vernova / GE Hitachi engineering experience.
  • Reactor protection, Emergency Core Cooling System (ECCS), digital I&C, NUMAC, or legacy GE I&C experience.
  • BWR plant modifications, modernization, system safety, or failure analysis experience.
  • Experience working under NQA-1 and 10 CFR 50 Appendix B quality programs.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

  • Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.
  • Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.
  • A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

  • Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

$120,000—$170,000 USD

From next-generation aerospace solutions to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. About this Role

In this role, you will be supporting the accounting team of a global company. You will play a significant role in maintaining the financial books and records and managing the accounting operations for vendors and suppliers. You Will...

  • Complete bank reconciliations for various foreign bank accounts
  • Perform complex reconciliations of payment processor fees from multiple payment processors, including the management of those accounts
  • Review and enter vendor bills
  • Be responsible for inventory purchase accounting, reconciliations, and routine ledger entries
  • Prepare journal entry documentation, book routine accruals and adjustment entries, and perform month-end account reconciliations. Identify and resolve discrepancies across sub-ledgers and the general ledger

  • 2+ years of professional experience in a similar position
  • Advanced computer skills (including G Suite and Microsoft Office, especially Excel)

  • Accuracy, timeliness, and patience
  • Good analytical and numerical skills
  • Ability to identify discrepancies between POs, contracts, and invoices, ensuring precision in data entry and general ledger entries
  • Capability to troubleshoot transactional discrepancies, balance sub-ledgers, and propose workflow optimizations
  • Fluent Polish (written & spoken) – Required for maintaining Polish statutory books and ensuring compliance with local authorities
  • Advanced English (written & spoken) – Required for daily professional communication with international accounting teams and cross-functional partners
  • Professional communication skills with the ability to build collaborative working relationships across functions
  • Collaborative, proactive, and willing to participate in a variety of international financial projects

Bonus Points...

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or similar enterprise ERP software

Benefits & Perks

Fandom is the world’s largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Reaching more than 350 million unique visitors per month and hosting more than 250,000 wikis, Fandom is the #1 source for in-depth information on pop culture, gaming, TV, and film, where fans learn about and celebrate their favorite fandoms. description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Implementation Consultant I is a key member of the Implementation team, contributing to the successful delivery of complex, large‑scale enterprise deployments of the PerfectServe platform. In this role, the consultant works within diverse health systems—including multi‑hospital networks and enterprise physician groups—to support full‑cycle implementation activities.

This position is designed for consultants who are ready to expand their project ownership, take the lead on defined workstreams within major deployments, and gain expertise across multiple product platforms based on project needs. Flexibility, adaptability, and a growth mindset are essential as this role evolves toward greater technical depth and project leadership responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Deployment & Project Leadership

  • Lead assigned workstreams within large-scale enterprise implementations, ensuring deliverables are completed on schedule and aligned with project goals.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution across complex environments.
  • Support planning and execution of enterprise go-live events, serving as a primary point of contact for designated functional areas.

Client Engagement & Workflow Consulting

  • Provide workflow consulting for physician, clinical, and operational teams.
    • Educate and register physicians for PerfectServe programs, designing elegant solutions that meet the system level standards established
    • Provide consultation support to physicians with call workflow configuration into the PerfectServe system
  • Develop training programs tailored to large health system audiences.

Technical Execution & Integration

  • Work with third party systems to integrate solutions into the PerfectServe system.
  • Conduct testing across devices, platforms, and integrated technologies.

Cross-Platform Training & Skill Development

  • Become trained across multiple PerfectServe platforms based on project needs.

Any other duties as needed to effectively perform the position

Essential Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, engineering or IT related discipline is ideal but not required
  • Prior work experience in a customer facing or other service roles
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Excellent computer skills using Microsoft Visio (or Lucidchart similarly), Word, Excel (including functions), and PowerPoint. Will be using Lucidchart extensively.

PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator - Contract
description:
About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both — giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

We're opening a large volume of new roles, to be hired through the first half of 2027. Every one of them means interview loops spread across Australian, US and European time zones, candidates waiting to hear what's next, Greenhouse stages to keep clean, and new starters who need contracts, checks and a laptop before day one. Our recruitment team needs support with the coordination and scheduling that comes with this many roles. We need someone to make sure activities and conversations happen on time and in the right order, that everyone's informed, and that candidates have a great experience throughout.

This role is for an experienced recruitment coordinator. You'll need to have done this job before and be able to hit the ground running from your first week. With this much hiring underway, there isn't room to learn recruitment coordination on the job. If you haven't worked as a recruitment coordinator or in talent operations, this role isn't the right fit.

You'll own scheduling, candidate communications, Greenhouse admin and the handover from hire to onboarding in HiBob, end to end.

As a team member, you'll work with recruiters, hiring managers and the wider People team. Our process is deliberately human — every candidate talks to a real person at every stage — so speed can't come at the cost of how candidates are treated. Some of our processes are still being refined, so so you'll need to be comfortable with being a bit scrappy at times.

Scheduling one interview across three time zones is easy. Doing it all week without a candidate ever feeling the effort is kind of the crux of the job.

The Sort Of Things You'll Do

Keep candidates moving

  • Schedule interview loops across Australian, US and European time zones, and rebook them quickly when plans change.
  • Move candidates through stages in Greenhouse and send the communication that goes with each step, so no one is left waiting to hear back.
  • Jump in on other recruitment/people activities when needed.

Keep the system clean

  • Build job posts, stages and interview kits in Greenhouse from our templates.
  • Own reporting and data hygiene, so recruiters and hiring managers can trust what the pipeline tells them.
  • Find the friction in how we coordinate and fix it, using AI tools like Claude where they help.

Get new starters in the door

  • Coordinate background checks, contracts and letters in HiBob once an offer is accepted.
  • Manage the handover to IT and answer new starter questions before day one.
  • Support our onboarding education program: hiring manager follow-up, group sessions and welcome sessions.

This Is You If...

  • You've worked as a recruitment coordinator or in talent operations, and you can walk us through a heavy week and how you kept it under control.
  • You know how a hiring process runs end to end and can take on a full scheduling load from your first week.
  • You catch errors before they reach anyone else — a wrong time zone, a duplicate candidate, a stage that hasn't moved — and you can give us an example.
  • You can juggle competing requests from recruiters and hiring managers across time zones and decide what goes first without being told.
  • You write to candidates the way you'd want to be written to: clear, prompt, and with the next step spelled out.
  • You're comfortable where processes aren't written down yet, and you use AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work.

Bonus Points If...

  • You've used Greenhouse: job posts, stages, interview kits or reporting.
  • You've used HiBob, or a similar HR system, for hiring or onboarding.
  • You've worked in SaaS or tech.
  • You've coordinated onboarding for new starters.

A Typical Day Might Include

  • Rebooking a four-person interview loop after an interviewer drops out the day before, and letting the candidate know what's changed.
  • Finding a slot that works for interviewers in Australia, the US and Europe.
  • Building the Greenhouse job post and interview kits for a newly opened engineering role.
  • Cleaning up stale stages and duplicate candidates so the pipeline report is right.
  • Chasing a background check and getting a contract out in HiBob.
  • Running a welcome session for this month's new starters.
  • Reviewing applications with a recruiter and talking through why some move forward.
  • Noticing the same scheduling email gets rewritten every week and turning it into a template.

Benefits

  • 20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 for secondary)
  • Remote-work allowance for home-office equipment, co-working spaces, or alternate locations

title: Test Developer
description:
Are you an experienced professional in test development and assessment program management? Looking for a fully remote position that provides flexibility? This is for you.

Summary of Position
This role supports the development and maintenance of assessments for credentialing and other organizations conducting high-stakes assessments. Working with psychometricians, client representatives, subject matter experts and others, the Test Developer coordinates item development, facilitates content reviews, maintains item banks, assembles examination forms, and prepares project documentation. The ideal candidate will have experience in these activities.

Key Responsibilities

Item development
  • Coordinate item writing and review assignments for client subject matter experts (SMEs)
  • Train and support SMEs in item writing best practices
  • Facilitate item writing and review meetings
  • Review and edit items for fairness, clarity, consistency and adherence to item writing guidelines

Item banking and exam development
  1. Import items into item banking software
  2. Manage item banks, maintaining accurate item content and metadata
  3. Monitor item inventory and prepare gap analyses
  4. Assemble examination forms using documented specifications and psychometric guidance
  5. Conduct quality assurance reviews of items, answer keys, and examination forms

Product delivery and project management
  • Coordinate assigned activities across multiple client projects, balancing deadlines, priorities and resources
  • Lead and work collaboratively with team in project planning and management
  • Communicate clearly with clients and SMEs regarding assignments, progress, decisions, and outstanding actions.
  • Track development milestones, item counts, and deliverables and communicate progress with stakeholders
  • Manage client expectations
  • Ensure successful product/project delivery
  • Educate clients in best practices in assessment and use of our software
  • Provide support for exam publishing, delivery, and results processing of items to authors, scheduling meetings to approve work done.

Client services and relationship management
  • Build trust for long-term retention of customers
  • Serve as point of contact for clients, learning their business and assessments
  • Onboard new clients and assure successful use of software
  • Contribute to continuous improvement in test development service delivery and procedures

Minimum Qualifications
  • Two or more years of experience in assessment project/program management, preferably in Credentialing
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in an assessment-related field (e.g. Psychology, Education, or Human Resources), or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • High level of organizational skills
  • Working knowledge of test development principles (e.g., job analysis, standard setting)
  • Excellent speaking, writing, and presentation skills in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and Google Suite

Preferred or Desired Qualifications
  • Past experience at a credentialing or educational assessment organization
  • Experience in using item banking and online exam platforms
  • Understanding of Project Management principles
  • Strong initiative, able to work independently in a fully remote company
  • Desire to learn and update job knowledge
  • Experience with NCCA or ANSI accreditation of certification programs

Company Background
Assessment Systems Corporation (ASC) is a leading provider of robust web-based assessment platforms built upon leading-edge psychometrics. We operate in several market segments where people are assessed on their skills, knowledge, and performance, including Certification/Licensure, Education, and Workforce. Our goal is to help ensure that organizations that are assessing people are doing so most effectively and fairly, by leveraging best practices, sound psychometric science, and efficient technology.

Additional Information
Compensation: Target compensation for this position is $60-75k/year, depending on experience
Supervisory Responsibility: This position has no direct supervisory responsibility
Work Environment: Assessment Systems is a fully virtual company. Dress is typically casual, except for client and SME meetings.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, use a computer, and organize paper materials.
Expected Hours of Work: Hours of work and days are typically Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. in a USA time zone.
Travel: Up to 5% (typically one week per year)
Paperwork: Assessment Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Assessment Systems is an E-Verify participating employer. Employment is contingent upon a successful background check.

title: Global Entity Operations Associate
description:
Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Contract type: Full-time

Salary: Starting from €35,000 per annum gross, subject to location, skills and experience

Not Your Typical Workplace.…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building atWorkMotion. Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role...

We don’t just need a Global Entity Operations Associate (internal title: Global Entity Infrastructure Associate) — we need a builder, problem-solver, and operator who can bring structure to complexity and keep WorkMotion’s global infrastructure running smoothly. We’re looking for someone who gets their energy from solving complex operational challenges, coordinating across borders, and turning moving parts into clear, scalable processes, while keeping a sharp eye on compliance, accuracy, and business impact.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of WorkMotion’s global entity infrastructure — driving day-to-day entity operations, coordinating compliance obligations, supporting international expansion, and helping build the infrastructure that enables WorkMotion to operate compliantly around the world. From license renewals and corporate filings to entity set-up, provider management, audits, and process improvements, you’ll help ensure everything you touch is accurate, compliant, well-organised, and built to scale.

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate closely with Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, Legal, and other internal teams, while coordinating with external legal, corporate, compliance, and local infrastructure partners across multiple jurisdictions. You’ll become a trusted point of contact for entity-related matters, bringing people, information, and timelines together to ensure consistency, accountability, and momentum across WorkMotion’s global operations.

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Manage daily operations and corporate maintenance activities of WorkMotion’s global entities, ensuring compliance and operational efficiency across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Track and drive corporate compliance obligations, including license renewals, UBO reporting, KYC filings, corporate governance tasks, etc., while working with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Help execute WorkMotion’s international expansion strategy by helping to manage the set-up of entities and the operating infrastructure for WorkMotion across the globe to employ compliantly worldwide.
  • Source, select, and manage external partners and providers that are part of our local EOR infrastructure.
  • Support with project management of various expansion or improvement initiatives related to our global infrastructure, as well as special company and strategic projects.
  • Collaborate with WorkMotion’s internal Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, and Legal teams, and serve as a point of contact for entity-related queries.
  • Maintain and update documents, records, and data to ensure accuracy and audit-readiness.
  • Support audits, regulatory inspections, and internal reviews by preparing necessary documentation.
  • Identify and solve problems, inefficiencies, or gaps in our entity management systems and internal processes.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, International Affairs, or other relevant field.
  • 2+ years of work experience, with prior roles in international operations, project management, entity set-up/maintenance, or relevant work in legal operations or compliance management.
  • Project management skills, with the ability to take lead on initiatives, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and manage timelines.
  • Open-minded and organized work attitude, with the ability to respond flexibly across a varying set of topics and tasks.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and team-player skills to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in high-paced dynamic environments.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can anticipate challenges and risks, and look for solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation practices.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Bonus Points If You Bring...

  • Experience in entity management, legal/paralegal work, or project coordination roles.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments, ideally in FinTech, SaaS, or multinational operations.
  • An understanding of corporate governance, entity compliance, regulatory obligations, and operational risk management in a global context.
  • Experience working asynchronously in a remote-first or globally distributed environment.

Not Your Typical Team…

We are a team of 26 highly talented Finance minds, who are based in Ukraine, Germany, Egypt and Austria. We’re a team of motivated, and fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected."

We don’t just “work” together — we create, challenge, and grow together. If you’re looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, cross-collaboration on bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork you’ll feel right at home.

The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on . We’re here to support you every step of the way!

description:
About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)

  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.
