title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment.

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Développeur Backend PHP (Alternance 12 mois)
description:
A propos de Lemonway

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

Le Poste

L'équipe est composée d'une Product Manager, un Engineering Manager 2 développeurs BACK PHP et 2 développeurs FRONT (Typescript / React). Intégrée au sein de la Squad MERCHANT, dédiée aux outils et services à destination de nos marchands partenaires, nous fonctionnons en Scrum avec des sprints de deux semaines et une livraison continue.

Voici les principales informations sur l'équipe :

  • L'amélioration continue et la capacité à délivrer une qualité toujours au rendez-vous sont des enjeux très forts au sein de cette équipe.

  • Au sein de la squad MERCHANT, nous développons et maintenons des APIs Backend utilisées par nos marchands pour interagir avec la plateforme de paiement Paygreen by Lemonway.

📌 Les missions principales

Contribuer au développement de notre offre produit

  • Participer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur les APIs Backend PHP exposées aux marchands.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et les développeurs seniors pour s'assurer que les solutions développées répondent aux besoins des marchands et aux standards de la plateforme.

Participer à la gestion du legacy

  • Analyser et comprendre le code existant pour identifier les zones nécessitant une refonte ou une optimisation.

  • Contribuer aux chantiers de réduction de la dette technique en collaboration avec l'équipe.

  • Participer à la refactorisation du code selon les bonnes pratiques, sous la supervision de développeurs expérimentés.

Contribuer à la documentation et aux process

  • Rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire pour les APIs développées.

  • Appliquer les guidelines de développement de l'équipe et contribuer à leur amélioration.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'utilisation des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser les contrôles qualité.

Améliorer la qualité du code

  • Participer aux revues de code et progresser grâce aux retours de l'équipe.

  • Contribuer à l'écriture de tests unitaires et d'intégration pour sécuriser les livraisons.

  • Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement backend et monter en compétence sur les enjeux de performance et de sécurité des APIs.


Que recherchons nous ?

  • Une formation en cours (Bac+3 à Bac+5) en développement informatique ou école d'ingénieurs.

  • Des bases solides en PHP et une envie d'approfondir tes connaissances backend.

  • Une première expérience ou connaissance des APIs REST.

  • Une connaissance ou un intérêt pour les bases de données relationnelles SQL/Postgres.

  • Un esprit d'équipe fort : tu sais poser des questions, t'appuyer sur tes collègues et partager ce que tu apprends.

  • Une curiosité technique et une sensibilité à la qualité du code.

  • La capacité à lire de la documentation en anglais.

** Notez qu’on propose un alternance de 12 mois à démarrer en Janvier 2027. Ce point n’est pas modifiable. Si votre école ne vous permet pas d’accepter un contrat d’alternance de 12 mois, nous ne pourrons pas confirmer l’alignement.

Le process de recrutement 

  1. Interview RH

  1. Interview Manager : échange avec l'Engineering Manager et un membre de la squad, pour discuter des missions et des attentes du poste.

  1. Entretien technique : exercice pratique pour évaluer tes bases en développement backend.

Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant la mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

  • Networking auf High-Level: Du erschließt gezielt exklusive Netzwerke in deiner Community und im akademischen Raum, um nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Protect what matters. 

Primion Technology is a global solution provider and market leader in Converged Security Solutions and Workforce Management. For more than 30 years, we have supported around 5,000 satisfied customers worldwide who rely on our certified solutions every day. From consulting and planning to development, installation, maintenance, and support, a team of over 470 dedicated experts works passionately to meet the highest standards. 

PRIMION France is a key growth market within PRIMION's European expansion strategy, focusing on delivering enterprise-grade, software-centric solutions to mid-size and large organizations across French territory.

As an Account Executive (m/f/d), you will acquire new customers and expand PRIMION's presence across enterprise and mid-market organizations. Positioning our integrated software solutions as strategic business enablers, you will guide prospects through the full sales cycle, from lead qualification and solution discovery to contract negotiation and close.

If you enjoy building relationships, uncovering opportunities, and turning them into sustainable business growth, then this role could be the perfect fit for you.

Ready to make an impact? Join us in France within a remote first working approach and play a key role in accelerating PRIMION's growth across one of our most important European markets.

Your Responsibilities

  • New Business Development

    • Identify, target, and develop new enterprise and mid-market accounts across France, with a focus on PRIMION's key verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Logistics, Public Sector, Financial Services).

    • Build and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline to consistently achieve and exceed annual revenue targets.

    • Execute structured prospecting activities including outbound outreach, event networking, partner co-selling, and inbound lead follow-up.

  • Solution Selling & Consultative Engagement

    • Conduct detailed discovery conversations to uncover customer pain points around security compliance (NIS2/KRITIS), workforce efficiency, operational risk, and digital transformation.

    • Position PRIMION's integrated software portfolio as a strategic solution rather than a point product, articulating total cost of ownership and business value.

    • Collaborate with Pre-Sales Engineers to design tailored solution architectures and compelling proposals.

  • Sales Cycle Management

    • Own the full end-to-end sales cycle from first contact to signed contract.

    • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving IT, Security, Operations, Compliance, HR, and C-level decision-makers.

    • Lead commercial negotiations and work with management to structure commercially sound agreements.

    • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and provide reliable pipeline forecasting.

  • Market & Account Intelligence

    • Develop deep knowledge of the French market landscape, competitive dynamics, and regulatory environment (NIS2, KRITIS, DORA, and relevant French legislation).

    • Identify whitespace opportunities within existing accounts and coordinate with Customer Success for expansion.

    • Represent PRIMION at French industry events, trade fairs, and sector-specific forums.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to ensure seamless customer experiences and aligned go-to-market execution.

    • Provide market feedback to help shape product roadmap priorities and localization requirements for the French market.


Key Qualifications

  • Must-Have

    • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 3 years in software or SaaS/enterprise technology solutions.

    • Strong hunter mentality with the drive to identify opportunities, build pipeline, and win new business.

    • Demonstrated success in closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 6-figure+ contract values.

    • Experience selling to enterprise accounts in at least one of PRIMION's target verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Logistics, Manufacturing, Public Sector, or Financial Services).

    • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

    • Comfortable navigating complex organizational structures and building relationships at C-level, VP, and Director level.

    • Native or fluent French speaker; professional English proficiency for internal collaboration.

    • Based in France with the ability and willingness to travel extensively across the territory, with a particular focus on Southern France.

  • Nice-to-Have

    • Experience with physical security, access control, video surveillance, or workforce management solutions.

    • Familiarity with NIS2, KRITIS, or similar European cybersecurity/compliance frameworks relevant to critical infrastructure operators.

    • Experience working with channel partners and system integrators as part of a go-to-market model.

    • Exposure to identity management, OT/IT security convergence, or PSIM platforms.

    • Formal sales methodology certification (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN Selling, or similar).

 

What We Offer

Protect what matters – Powered by People. At Primion, we lead with human responsibility and win through collaboration. Our aim is to build long-term relationships based on mutual respect and trust.

That's why we offer you:

  • Impact: Benefit from a high-impact, high-autonomy commercial role with significant territory ownership and the opportunity to directly influence PRIMION's growth across the French market.

  • Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary complemented by a capped, performance-based variable compensation structure that rewards success.

  • Stability: Benefit from the backing of an established European technology brand with a 30+ year track record, strong R&D investment, and a clear multi-year growth strategy.

  • Market Opportunity: Capitalize on growing market demand driven by regulatory developments such as NIS2 and KRITIS, creating strong opportunities for customer acquisition and business growth.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Pre-Sales experts, Customer Success Managers, and Product specialists to develop compelling customer solutions and drive successful sales outcomes.

  • Excellence: Continuously develop your expertise through PRIMION's sales enablement resources, industry insights, and proven vertical playbooks.

  • Growth: Grow with a business that is actively expanding across European markets while taking on increasing responsibility and shaping future market success.

  • Equipment: Benefit from a company car as well as modern business equipment, including a company phone and laptop, to support your daily work and customer engagements.

Have we piqued your interest?

Then we look forward to receiving your application!

title: Founding Account Executive
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As our Founding Account Executive, you will own go-to-market execution as the first dedicated sales hire, working directly alongside the CEO. We are moving fast and demand is accelerating. Founder-led sales has taken us this far, and now it is time to expand the commercial engine. That is where you come in. You will own the day-to-day execution of the full sales cycle and build the playbook as you go, working directly with the CEO on strategy, pricing, and positioning. Early on this is a true partnership: the founder is in the room with you on the key deals, and as you build the motion you take more and more of it end to end. You are the player-coach of our sales team, and you play both parts at once: on the field closing deals yourself now, and building and coaching the team that closes the next hundred.

This role is strategy and execution in one. You will help set commercial direction, then close deals personally until there is enough revenue to justify a team beneath you. Expect heavy customer time: site visits, pilot scoping, and direct relationships with security operators and decision-makers. If you want a defined playbook handed to you, this is not the role. If you want to write it, this is.

What You'll Work On

  • Full-cycle sales: source, qualify, run discovery and demos, negotiate, and close customers.

    • Enterprise B2B: win and grow commercial customers across enterprise and industrial critical infrastructure, where cycles move faster and land-and-expand is the play.

    • Public sector and defence (B2G): run the longer government and defence cycles, including procurement, tenders, and framework agreements.

  • Pilots to contracts: scope, sell, and run paid pilots (POCs) that convert into long-term contracts.

  • Founder-led sales, transitioned: co-sell the key early deals with the CEO, then take them fully end to end as the playbook takes shape.

  • Pipeline and CRM: keep every opportunity clean and current, with follow-ups that never slip.

  • The playbook: capture what works, sharpen the ICP, and feed real customer signal back to product.

  • Forecasting: honest and ambitious pipeline.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for a hunter, not a coin-operated salesperson. You have carried a full-cycle B2B number and personally closed, not just generated pipeline. You are comfortable in a room with a head of security, a head of operations, a government procurement lead, and a technical engineer, and you can switch registers between them. You treat customers as relationships to earn, not deals to extract, because in critical infrastructure trust is the whole game. Above all, you want to own and build a commercial function, not run a quota inside someone else's playbook.

Your Background

  • 5+ years of full-cycle enterprise B2B sales, with a verifiable record of closing six-figure plus deals.

  • Proven at self-sourcing pipeline; you do not wait for inbound to save you.

  • AI-fluent and unmistakably human. You are proficient with AI tools and use them to research, draft, and move faster, but you stay fully plugged in: you use your own judgment, bring high EQ, read the room, and build real relationships.

  • Technically literate. You do not need to code, but you must credibly sell a genuinely technical product to sophisticated buyers.

  • Organised and self-directed on the unglamorous parts: follow-ups, CRM hygiene, and clean deal documentation.

  • High agency, high reliability, high ambition.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich.

Nice to Have

  • Background selling deeptech, hardware, security, robotics, computer vision, or complex enterprise software.

  • Experience with a subscription or recurring-revenue product.

  • An existing network of security operators, integrators, or buyers in DACH and UK.

  • German language proficiency.

  • Startup or early-stage experience, ideally as an early or founding sales hire. You are comfortable with ambiguity and no infrastructure.

What We Offer

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

  • Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

  • Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

  • Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

  • Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

  • Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

  • Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.

Your Background

  • 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.

  • Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.

  • Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).

  • Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.

  • Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.

  • Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.

Nice to Have

  • Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.

  • Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).

  • Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.

  • Robotics or field data collection.

  • Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.

What We Offer

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer
description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

Job title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer

Location : Lausanne, Switzerland

The Physical Design (PD) Engineer translates high-speed communication IP digital designs into physical GDSII layouts for advanced FinFET nodes. You will bridge logic design, owning block-to-chip implementation from netlist to final physical sign-off, ensuring PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) targets are met.

 

Immediate key objective

  • Drive block-level physical implementation—covering synthesis, SDC constraints, floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing—meeting strict frequency, area, and power targets.

  • Execute timing closure across multiple corners and modes (MCMM) utilizing static timing analysis (STA) and generating targeted ECOs.

  • Drive full physical verification closure sign-off in deep-submicron FinFET technologies.

Responsibility

  • Own block synthesis, floorplanning, placement optimization, CTS, and routing.

  • Develop and refine SDC constraints to ensure design intent matches physical realization.

  • Collaborate with the digital design team to resolve logic or architectural bottlenecks affecting P&R convergence.

  • Generate progress reports, document implementation flows, and prepare sign-off packages for tape-out.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on physical design experience focusing on synthesis, SDC constraints, CTS, and place and route for high-speed systems.

  • Strong technical background in deep-submicron CMOS/FinFET physical effects, crosstalk, and high-frequency clock network design.

  • Proven experience of taking complex blocks from netlist through successful physical implementation.

  • Direct experience with advanced low-power implementation techniques (UPF, power gating).

  • Proven tape-out experience in advanced FinFET nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm).

  • Experience handling complex block-to-chip hierarchical assembly, pin placement, and top-level routing constraints..

Required Skills

  • Expert proficiency with industry-standard implementation and sign-off tools (e.g., Cadence Genus/Innovus/Tempus or Synopsys Design Compiler/ICC2/PrimeTime, and Calibre).

  • Deep understanding of SDC creation, and MCMM timing management.

  • Strong scripting skills (Tcl, Python) for flow automation and design data analysis.

  • Analytical mindset to debug congestion routing issues, and complex timing violations.

  • Self-motivated with strong sense of ownership; effective communicator and team player

Required Education

  • Masters or Ph.D. in E.E., Communications or other relevant fields

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customer’s broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

title: HR Technology & Analytics Specialist
description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

HR Technology & Analytics Specialist

The HR Technology and Analytics Specialist supports HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics activities, with a focus on Workday HCM. The role provides day-to-day HRIS support, develops and maintains standard and moderately complex reports, assists with system enhancements and testing, and supports HR data quality and governance processes. The position works with HR, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver accurate reporting and dashboards.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on HR systems and reporting experience with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

HR Technology Support

  • Provide day-to-day functional support for Workday and other HR technology platforms.
  • Troubleshoot HR technology issues, research root causes, and coordinate resolution with HR, IT, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Gather and document business requirements and support the development, testing, and deployment of Workday configuration changes under the guidance of senior HR Technology or IT resources.
  • Identify and support process improvement opportunities by reviewing Workday system releases, documenting potential enhancements, and participating in approved HR technology enhancement projects.
  • Support employee and manager self-service adoption through user guidance, training, support materials, and approved system or process enhancements.
  • Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, integrations, and process improvement initiatives by completing assigned tasks or workstreams and escalating complex design decisions.
  • Create and maintain system configuration documentation, process guides and end-user support materials for HR technology platforms and processes.

HR Analytics and Reporting

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance standard and moderately complex Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics based on established HR and business requirements.
  • Create and maintain calculated fields and report logic within Workday to support standard and moderately complex workforce reporting requirements, seeking guidance for advanced designs.
  • Use Workday reporting and analytics capabilities to validate data, summarize workforce trends, and respond to defined HR and business reporting needs.
  • Develop and support recurring and ad hoc HR compliance reporting, including data validation and reconciliation to promote accuracy and timely delivery.
  • Maintain and enhance established HR metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports.
  • Summarize analytical findings and key trends clearly for technical and non-technical audiences, escalating requests that require advanced analysis or recommendations.
  • Support HR stakeholders by preparing workforce reporting and summarizing key trends.
  • Work with HR and IT stakeholders to document and validate HR data requirements and support testing for workforce data integrations and cross-functional dashboards, escalating complex integration design matters.

Data Governance and Quality

  • Maintain a centralized inventory of HR reports and documented definitions for workforce data and metrics.
  • Monitor HR data quality and proactively identify inconsistencies or data integrity issues.
  • Apply established HR data standards and governance practices and support related documentation, data quality checks, and issue follow-up.
  • Perform audits and reconciliations to ensure HR data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
  • Support the maintenance of established definitions for key workforce metrics and reporting dimensions, and document approved updates in partnership with HR stakeholders.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality and security when working with sensitive employee information.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Analytics, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in HRIS, HR analytics, HR reporting, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday HCM.
  • Experience creating standard and moderately complex Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.
  • Working knowledge of HR data structures, workforce metrics, and HR business processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills.
  • Ability to communicate findings clearly and work with HR and IT stakeholders.
  • Experience handling confidential and sensitive employee information.

Preferred

  • Experience using a business intelligence or visualization platform, preferably Power BI, to develop dashboards and communicate workforce insights.
  • Knowledge of HR data governance and reporting security.
  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organizational reporting, or established HR dashboards.

Travel

• 10% for occasional team and company meetings

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

The opportunity

Help Scout is building a sales-led outbound motion to win more mid-market customers. Most of our pipeline comes from inbound today & we are changing that mix. This role is the engine for it.

We're hiring our first Business Development Representative to join our sales team. In this role, you’ll open conversations with the companies that fit us best and drive pipeline for our Account Executives. You'll also help shape the outbound playbook: which accounts, which messages, and which channels work. As our first BDR, we’re not looking for someone to run an established playbook… we're looking for someone who is eager to help shape one.

Does that sound like you? If so, here’s more about the role:

What you’ll do

  • Research and personalize. Use an AI tech stack to find the right prospects, from Support/Success leaders to Operations management and company executives. You'll maximize engagement by tailoring outreach using our messaging frameworks and templates, and will check AI-generated drafts before sending.

  • Work defined target account lists. Prospect into a defined list of ideal-fit mid-market companies based on our ICP criteria & strategic campaigns, and flag accounts that are not the right fit.

  • Execute multi-channel outreach. Manage outreach across several channels, including email, phone, LinkedIn, and video.

  • Test and iterate. Run messaging, personas, and channels tests, track what converts at the highest rates, and recommend changes to drive continuous improvement.

  • Report on results. Maintain updated reports and dashboards that illustrate your success rates across campaigns and performance towards your targets. Regularly review results and thoughtful recommendations for improvement with your manager.

  • Hand off cleanly. Partner closely with Account Executives to brief them on sourced meetings with well documented details about the contacts, accounts and messaging that led to the booking. Use AE feedback to regularly improve your hand-offs.

About you

  • You’re relentless and resourceful. When a prospect doesn’t answer, you find another way in: a different channel, a different person, a different angle.

  • You take initiative. You’ve built or tested something in your outbound process without being asked, and you can tell us what happened.

  • You have 1 to 2+ years as an outbound BDR or SDR at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of meeting pipeline or opportunity targets.

  • You've prospected into companies with 250+ employees and know how to tailor messaging based on industry, job title and additional criteria.

  • You’re a great communicator, both with prospects and internal colleagues.

  • You actively use AI tools in your workflow for research, list building, or writing, and can recommend what works (experience with HubSpot & GTM platforms like Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator or similar solutions a plus).

  • You can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • You're coachable and want to grow into a closing role.

Compensation and benefits

We use a competency-based approach to pay, and pay is the same no matter where in the U.S. you live.

Base salary: $71,000 - $77,000

On-target earnings (OTE): $102,000 - $111,000

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

title: B2B Sales Closer (SaaS)
description:
This role is only for experienced B2B SaaS closers.

Please apply only if all of the following are true:
• At least 3 years of B2B SaaS sales experience
• You have personally closed B2B SaaS deals of $20,000+ per year with new customers
• You can name these deals (product, client, annual value) and provide a reference
• Native or bilingual English

Applications that don’t meet these requirements are not eligible for further review.

* Employment: Full-time, long-term, remote

* Language: Fluent/Bilingual English

Keepgo is a global mobile internet provider offering innovative products and solutions based on virtual technologies, primarily eSIM. (, , )

Since 2012, Keepgo has been global connectivity provider for IoT, M2M and consumer devices, with access to 200+ cellular networks in 150+ countries, powered by the Telefónica global network.

We are growing and looking for an experienced B2B Sales Closer to drive revenue of Keepgo’s B2B solutions across our products.

Main goal - convert qualified leads into long-term customers through consultative selling, strong product demos and consistent follow-up. Warm leads are provided.

You will manage small and mid-size deals independently and work alongside the company’s founders on enterprise deals.

Responsibilities:

* Manage qualified inbound opportunities throughout the entire sales cycle, from initial engagement to payment.

* Qualify incoming leads and determine the right sales approach for each client.

* Close small and mid-size deals independently, from first contact to signed agreement.

* Conduct discovery calls, product demos with B2B clients.

* Handle objections, negotiate commercial terms and confidently ask for the business.

* Communicate with leads through email, WhatsApp and LinkedIn until successful payment.

* Support enterprise deals together with the founders by preparing proposals, follow-ups and demos, and by taking part in client meetings.

* Build trust with customers by understanding their business needs and providing tailored solutions.

* Continuously develop product and industry knowledge through our structured onboarding training and practical experience.

* Maintain accurate records in the CRM, with a clear next step for every deal.

* Collaborate with outreach, marketing, product and sales leadership to achieve shared goals.

Requirements (must-have):

* At least 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology sales, preferably in a closing or full-cycle sales role.

* Demonstrated experience independently managing the full sales cycle, including prospect engagement, discovery, qualification, product demonstrations, negotiation, objection handling and closing.

* Strong command of the full sales cycle: discovery, qualification, objection handling, follow-up and closing

* Confidence conducting online sales meetings, product demonstrations and commercial negotiations.

* Tech-savvy and able to explain technical products clearly to non-technical clients

* Daily experience working with a CRM (HubSpot or similar)

* Open to feedback and ready to apply it quickly

Nice to have:

* Experience in telecom, mobile connectivity or IoT

* A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, telecommunications or a related field

* Native speaker of one of the following languages: English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, Japanese, Portuguese or Dutch

What We Offer:

* Fully remote, long-term role within an international team

* Competitive base salary plus performance-based commissions and additional rewards for exceeding targets

* Paid annual vacation

* Qualified warm leads provided by dedicated outreach and inbound teams

* Structured 1-month onboarding and training programme on our industry, products and use cases

* Opportunity to sell innovative international B2B tech products

* Impact-driven work with transparent, measurable results

* Collaborative and supportive work environment

Hiring Process:

1) a short AI pre-interview, 2. a practical test task, 3. two video interviews with our team, and a reference check.

Please note:
As part of our standard procedures, time-tracking software is required on the equipment during work hours.

title: Medical Science Liaison, Immunology
description:
• Provide scientific and technical leadership to ensure professional and credible relationships with thought leaders and external experts of strategic importance to AbbVie.

  • Ensure a strong medical and scientific presence for AbbVie in key academic centers by facilitation of research and educational initiatives, while supporting requests for medical and scientific information on products or areas of therapeutic interest to AbbVie.

  • Support internal teams such as sales and marketing and members of the Affiliate Brand Team to develop their scientific and technical expertise through the delivery of scientific update presentations. Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members while retaining functional independence.

  • Serve as a point of contact within the Medical Affairs team for thought leaders and external experts within the assigned therapeutic area in order to satisfy their needs for scientific knowledge in a therapeutic area and, when requested, relevant AbbVie medicines, to support their safe, effective and appropriate use.

  • Deliver credible presentations on scientific matters to physicians, individually or in groups (meetings, clinical sessions, etc.), where requested, with a focus on Tier 1 and Tier 2 thought leaders.

  • Participate in the selection process to identify appropriately qualified thought leaders the Company would wish to engage in collaborative efforts, such as potential research collaborations or educational and advisory roles (Advisory Boards, Congresses, Symposia, etc.), while ensuring a high level of scientific or educational integrity in these collaborative efforts.

  • Facilitate medical and scientific field intelligence, for example competitor research, medical strategies and educational activities, and communicate this within the Company where appropriate.

  • Attend relevant scientific meetings and conferences. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop summaries of key data and other scientifically relevant information to inform AbbVie strategic priorities and initiatives.

  • Provide key thought leaders / external experts and internal medical and clinical teams with scientific and technical support for publications of scientific or medical interest

  • Advanced degree (e.g. MD, PhD) in an Immunology scientific discipline is preferred.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining expert knowledge for the assigned therapeutic area, and in medical research in general.

  • Demonstrated expertise in the scientific methods applied to clinical research and current legislative/regulatory controls applicable to this research.

  • Ability to comprehensively learn about new subject areas and environments.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop and maintain strong collaborative relationships with thought leaders, physicians and other healthcare decision makers.

  • High customer orientation.

  • Strong commitment to compliance with the relevant rules and procedures, and to scientific quality and integrity

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit

US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
